flags.why: The alley sense is used mainly in Northern Vietnamese, as documented by [An Chi](https://petrotimes.vn/tu-nguyen-cua-hem-ngo-434676.html).
The corpse sense remains current and is not archaic; see [VDict](https://vdict.com/th%C3%A2y%20ma%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).

Calling a corpse 'thây ma' can express contempt and is unsuitable for respectful reference to the deceased; see [the dictionary definition](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/thay-ma-erdaZTrXwIgK6.html).
The entry omits the common weather use meaning overcast, where clouds block the sunshine; see [ZIM Dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/ram-tieng-anh-la-gi-8).
flags.fix: Add: adj | overcast (of the weather); ex: Hôm nay trời râm. = It is overcast today.
